title: Initiative Resonance Matrix and quarterly threading play
creator: Priya Desai
description:
Problem: Company-level OKRs are not consistently translated into discrete, cross-functional initiatives with clear owners, signals, capacity assumptions, and dependency maps. That causes duplicated work, misaligned rollouts, and unclear escalation paths.

Goal: Deliver an "Initiative Resonance Matrix" (IRM) and an associated quarterly threading playbook that product, engineering, and design teams use to: (1) map every company OKR to a set of prioritized initiatives, (2) capture quantitative signals/metrics and confidence bands, (3) call out owners and required dependencies, and (4) produce a one-page intake that feeds the roadmap and release lanes.

Scope: Create a lightweight, repeatable IRM template (Google Sheet + Confluence template), define a scoring rubric, run a pilot with three cross-functional initiatives for Q2 planning, update the roadmap with threaded lanes, and integrate key outputs into the Console roadmap dashboard and Linear ticketing metadata.

Out-of-scope: Full automation of scoring into Console dashboard (will be follow-up), and mandated headcount reallocation decisions (these remain managerial).
acceptance_criteria: A reusable IRM template exists in Google Drive and Confluence with fields: OKR mapping, initiative summary, owner, success signals (primary/guardrail), confidence estimate, RICE-like score, dependencies, suggested release lane, and risk notes.
Pilot completed for three initiatives with documented scores, one-page intake artifacts, and stakeholder sign-off from Eng, Design, and GTM owners.
Roadmap lanes and release slices for the three pilot initiatives are added to the canonical roadmap doc and visualized in the Console roadmap dashboard.
A retrospective from the pilot with at least 5 concrete improvements captured and a plan for next cycle is published in Confluence.
Template incorporated into Linear creation checklist for company-level initiatives (metadata mapping done).
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff with cross-functional core group (PM, Eng lead, Design lead, Infra representative). Agreed success criteria and pilot candidates (Model routing cache, Dedicated autoscaling policy, Console rollout UX).
2026-02-18: Prototype IRM v0.1 built in Google Sheet (link below). Preliminary scoring rubric adapted from RICE but replaced Reach with 'OKR Resonance' and added a 'Confidence' band column.

2026-02-25: Data sync: pulled historical telemetry for the three pilot initiatives (latency/cost deltas, error rates, infra capacity needs) and added to sheet to inform scoring. Assigned ENG data owner Liam Chen to maintain numbers.
2026-03-02: Stakeholder review session with SRE and Revenue Ops. Feedback captured — need clearer dependency tagging and mandatory owner escalation path. Added 'escalation contact' field to template.
2026-03-05: Aligned on pilot scoring thresholds and finalized pilot runbook. Ready to run pilot intake meetings next week.
decisions: Adopt 'Resonance-Impact' scoring: Resonance (how strongly initiative maps to company OKR) * Impact (expected value to OKR) / Cost (estimated effort) with a separate Confidence multiplier to bump/dampen prioritization.
Keep template intentionally lightweight (one-page intake) to reduce friction for owners — detailed engineering design remains in linked PRDs rather than the IRM.
Pilot will run on three initiatives only; broader rollout contingent on pilot retrospective and scoreboard thresholds.
review_feedback: Design (Sofia Martinez): template should include a product/UX signal (user task completion or NPS) and a mock for release comms. Request to add 'user-facing risk' row.
Engineering (Liam Chen): require cost estimates in standardized units (engineer-weeks or infra GPU-weeks). Provided a short guidance doc for conversions.
SRE (Avery Brooks): asked for explicit dependency tagging on infra teams and a pre-flight checklist for rollout readiness. Added 'infra owner' field and checklist link.

Revenue Ops (Maya Patel): requested an adoption metric and expected uplift range for GTM-related initiatives to feed funnel forecasts. Added 'expected revenue / adoption estimate' field for GTM initiatives.
next_steps: Schedule pilot intake meetings with three initiative owners (week of 2026-03-08). Owner invites to include Eng, Design, SRE, GTM counterpart.
Finalize Confluence template and lock fields that feed the roadmap ingestion helper (owner, estimated start, estimated end, release lane, dependencies).
Implement a small Linear form/checklist for company-level initiative creation that pre-populates the IRM link and required metadata. (ENG support ticket ENG-3678 to track).
Run pilot retrospective during 2026-04-07 cycle planning; capture improvements and decide on rollout scope for Q2->Q3.
